blocks.text: Macklemore releases his new single “WHERE’S OUR LOVE,” with all proceeds benefiting the Mother of Hind Fund, a humanitarian initiative founded by Wesam Hamada in memory of her daughter, Hind Rajab. The fund supports mothers and children in Gaza through financial and material assistance, mental health and trauma recovery programs, and community initiatives focused on long-term healing and rebuilding. The release follows Macklemore’s sold-out FREE PALESTINE TOUR, which brought together audiences at Dublin’s 3Arena on October 26, Paris’s Accor Arena on October 29 and London’s OVO Arena Wembley on October 30.
